info.title: Kyrazo Integration API
info.description: High-performance API for publishing events and managing webhook targets.

post.description: Publishes a single event to the specified project and its associated targets.

x-codeSamples.source:
client.events.publish(
    project_id='project_id',
    body=PublishEventBody(
        webhookId='wh_123',
        eventType='user.created',
        payload={'id': 1},
        targets=[{'targetId': '65a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456'}]
    )
)

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project.

post.description: Publishes multiple events in a single request.

x-codeSamples.source:
client.events.batch(
    project_id='project_id',
    body=[
        PublishEventBody(
            webhookId='wh_1',
            eventType='user.created',
            payload={'id': 1},
            targets=[{'targetId': '65a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456'}]
        ),
        PublishEventBody(
            webhookId='wh_2',
            eventType='order.created',
            payload={'id': 99},
            targets=[{'targetId': '65a1b2c3d4e5f67890123457'}]
        )
    ]
)

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of targets for the specified project.

x-codeSamples.source: const targets = await client.targets.list('project_id', { limit: 10, page: 1 });

post.description: Creates a new webhook target for the specified project.

x-codeSamples.source:
target = client.targets.create(
    project_id='project_id',
    data=CreateTargetInput(
        name='Production Webhook',
        url='https://api.example.com/webhooks',
        method='POST',
        config=TargetConfig(timeout=5000, retryCount=3, rateLimitDuration=60)
    )
)

error.message: Target with this url already exists

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific target.

patch.description: Updates properties of a specific target.

x-codeSamples.source: const target = await client.targets.update('project_id', 'target_id', { name: 'Updated Name', url: 'https://new-url.com' });

target = client.targets.update(
    project_id='project_id',
    target_id='target_id',
    data=UpdateTargetInput(name='Updated Name', url='https://new-url.com')
)

put.description: Enables or disables a specific target.

get.description: Retrieves the signing secret for the target.

        name='Backend Service',

    )

const endpoint = await client.endpoints.update('project_id', 'endpoint_id', { name: 'Updated Name', status: 'inactive' });

endpoint = client.endpoints.update(

        service='stripe',

        eventTypes=['charge.succeeded'],
